svg.aria-label: L298N DC motor driver board, editable detailed SVG, top view, 43 mm square
svg.title: L298N — editable realistic top-view SVG v3
svg.desc: Red L298N dual H bridge board, fully vector artwork derived from v2. Nominal 43x43 mm PCB, 37x37 mm four-hole pattern, 3.2 mm drilled holes. Capacitors with full-length dark polar sectors; sculpted Phillips/pozidriv-type screw slots; eight bridged SS34 diode bodies; comb heatsink fins and silkscreen. Visual reconstruction, not a manufacturing drawing.
